raw.details:
BUILD BATTLE

Web Development Hackathon

Build. Ship. Compete.

Build Battle is a competitive web development hackathon organized by Frontend Arena, designed to challenge developers to transform a common problem statement into a creative, functional, and impactful web solution.

Every participant will work on the same Problem Statement, but the final outcome will depend entirely on their ideas, technical skills, creativity, design, and execution.

One Problem. Different Minds. One Champion.

Event Overview

Build Battle is an individual-only web development hackathon where participants compete against each other by building solutions for a common challenge.

Participants will have the freedom to decide how they approach the problem, what technologies they use, and how they design and implement their solution.

The goal is simple:

Understand the problem. Build a solution. Stand out.

Participation

  • Individual Participation Only
  • Team participation is not allowed.
  • Open to students, developers, designers, freelancers, and web development enthusiasts.
  • Participants of all skill levels are welcome.

Evaluation Criteria

Criteria Weightage
Problem Understanding 15%
Functionality & User Experience 25%
UI/UX & Design 20%
Innovation & Creativity 15%
Technical Implementation 15%
Presentation & Demo 10%

AI & Vibe Coding

AI-assisted development and Vibe Coding are allowed.

Participants may use AI coding assistants, AI design tools, frameworks, libraries, APIs, and other development tools.

However, participants are expected to understand the solution they submit and should be able to explain their implementation when required.

AI can assist your development — but your ideas, decisions, and execution define your solution.

Rules & Guidelines

  • Build Battle is strictly individual participation only.
  • Each participant must develop and submit their own solution.
  • All submissions must be based on the official Problem Statement.
  • Participants may use their preferred technologies unless otherwise specified.
  • Third-party libraries, frameworks, APIs, and development tools are permitted unless restricted by the Problem Statement.
  • AI-assisted development and Vibe Coding are permitted.
  • Participants must submit their project within the announced deadline.
  • Plagiarism, copied projects, or unauthorized use of another participant's work may result in disqualification.
  • Participants may be asked to explain their implementation during evaluation or the final presentation.
  • The organizers reserve the right to disqualify submissions that violate the event rules.

Who Should Participate?

Build Battle is for anyone interested in building for the web, including:

  • Students
  • Frontend Developers
  • Full-Stack Developers
  • Web Developers
  • UI/UX Designers
  • Freelancers
  • Beginners
  • Developers exploring AI-assisted development

Whether you're just starting out or already building real-world products, Build Battle gives you a platform to put your skills to the test.

What to Expect

  • A real-world development challenge
  • Complete creative freedom in implementation
  • AI & Vibe Coding support
  • Competitive evaluation
  • Final project showcase
  • Certificate opportunities
  • Community recognition
  • An opportunity to prove your development skills

THE CHALLENGE IS SIMPLE.

Everyone gets the same problem.

What you build, how you build it, and how you solve it is entirely up to you.

ONE PROBLEM. DIFFERENT MINDS. ONE CHAMPION.

BUILD. SHIP. COMPETE.

Organized by Frontend Arena
